comments.author: CafeinSquirrel
comments.body_html: Hi, I’m the guy who makes Tarkov NPC battle videos. Your mod is exactly what I’ve been looking for, but I have a few suggestions. First, could you add an option to display bots HP as a percentage instead of a health bar? It becomes difficult to read when there are a lot of bots close to each other. It would also be great if the font could be changed to Bender, since it’s Escape from Tarkov main font. Another suggestion is about future bot spawn feature. I’ve tried a lot of spawning mods from both this website and Discord, but I haven’t found a single one that can properly register different bot types as part of the same squad when spawning them. For example: If I spawn Reshala and his guards individually, the guards would not recognize him as their leader, follow him, and properly utilize SAIN’s squad features/ friendly fire,… At the moment, most mods only support squads made up of the same bot type. For example, if you spawn five Raiders at the same time, the game automatically assigns the first Raider as the squad leader. However, this system doesn’t seem to work for spawning individual bot , such as bosses and their followers. Another feature that would be incredibly helpful is a bot hostility editor, allowing users to configure relationships between different factions and bot types. That would save me a huge amount of time when setting up NPC battles and making videos. (i edited them manually in the server files) Thanks again for your work.

comments.author: Kryptic-S01
comments.body_html:
From what I read in the Discord without going into too much detail, Refringe (a leading SPT dev) posted a message to clear some things up for everyone as it seems private DM’s were leaked out of context regarding the threat from BSG, which spooked Refringe enough into calling it quits. Altering/Changing the domain would simply not be enough to desway BSG’s legal notice into SPT as it would require a vast amount of migration of sensitive information, plus he has real-world responsibilities to deal with and he doesn’t want to be in the crosshairs, so to speak.

We still have just over a week before this website is closed down for good, but there still could be a small chance of someone taking the helm of the project if we are that lucky, but don’t hold your breathe on that.

As someone who has supported SPT since the very beginning back in late 2020-early ‘21, I am deeply saddened about what’s happening, but I am hopeful the project will continue just in a different place.
